basic_info.description: Nestled in coveted Cow Hollow, this lovingly maintained 1910 Victorian house exudes historic charm, coupled beautifully w/modern upgrades. Light-filled & features 11-ft ceilings, beautiful wood floors & intricate crown moldings throughout. Main level boasts a double parlor (additional bedroom), full bathroom w/stall shower & a versatile sitting room (office or breakfast nook). Open kitchen is equipped w/Sub-Zero refrigerator/freezer drawer, stone countertops, Bosch dishwasher, Wedgewood double oven range, hood vent, custom cabinetry & butler's pantry open to the formal dining room w/direct access to a deck through French doors. Upstairs, a skylit landing leads to 3 bedrooms, including a front bedroom w/bay windows & decorative fireplace flanked by built-in bookshelves. Hall bedroom offers ample closet space, while the back 1/2 of the upper level can be transformed into a primary suite w/sitting room, bedroom & cheery south-facing full bath w/large stall shower. Open laundry room & sunroom (playroom/office) are at the back of the home. 3-car garage w/ample storage space. Roof deck w/Golden Gate Bridge & some Bay views. 94 Walk Score: less than a block away to boutique shops, groceries, gyms, cafes & restaurants along Union St; Hamlin & Convent Schools are just a few blocks away.
